snippet.title: EXD - Extra Dimensional | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
An unexpected hero. A rift between worlds. A reality you can touch.
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3962020?utm_source=youtube_loi_reveal_trailer
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/UmqfPJScKg

EXD is a physics-based VR fantasy game. You are Max Ventura, a delivery guy catapulted into a another dimension. Hunt for Earth relics lost there millennia ago, now imbued with immense power. Use telekinesis and elemental forces: fire, ice, lightning. Discover the truth and save both universes.
Made for PCVR.
